title: "R Libraries"
format: pdf
---

## Data and Big Data Analysis

```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(dplyr) 
library(data.table) 
library(tidyquant)# tibble, essentially tidyverse for finance 
library(quantmod)# finance data 
```

## Plotting & Data Visualization

```{r}
library(ggplot2) 
library(plotly)# interactive statistical plot 
library(corrplot)# corr matrix graphical representation 
library(factoextra)# plot(FactoMineR) 
library(rpart.plot)# CART plot 
library(NeuralNetTools) # plot neural networks 
```

## Time Series and Forecasting

```{r}
library(forecast)# univariate analysis, ARIMA 
library(tseries)# time series analysis, regression, predictions and test 
library(rugarch)# ARCH-GARCH Model 
library(urca)# econometric test 
library(TSA)# test used for ARCH GARCH  
```

## Spatial Analysis

```{r}
library(sf)# integration of GIS and spatial data 
library(spdep)# spatial matrix 
library(spatialreg) # spatial econometrics 
```

## Statistical Tests

```{r}
library(lmtest)# test for linear regression model 
library(fNonlinear)# test the absence of linearity in data 
library(heplots)# test BOX M for LDA 
library(vcvComp)# study and compare variance covariance matrix
```

## Data Science

```{r}
library(rpart)# CART (classification and regression tree) (supervised machine learning) 
library(randomForest)# random forest (supervised machine learning) 
library(FactoMineR)# multivariate analysis (like PCA) 
library(nnet)# neural network 
library(MASS)# linear and quadratic discriminant analysis (LDA-QDA) (supervised) 
library(ROCR)# evaluating classification models
```

## Sampling

```{r}
library(sampling)# apply sample theory framework (access to different sampling methods) 
library(boot)# bootstrap method to estimate error bias and confidence interval 
```
